key_insight: FrugalEvo reframes LLM-guided evolution from maximizing improvement over a fixed budget to maximizing improvement per unit cost. It uses a high-capability LLM to explore promising strategies and a cheaper LLM to carry out the edits, aiming for better efficiency.
problem_solved: Prior LLM-guided evolutionary methods often ignore inference cost and optimize only performance across a set number of iterations. This paper addresses the need for cost-aware optimization in practical settings where both solution quality and compute budget matter.
method: Use a stronger, more expensive LLM to propose or explore candidate solution strategies.
Use a cheaper LLM to implement or refine those strategies, reducing overall cost.
Design the evolutionary process to prioritize gain per unit cost rather than raw gain over fixed iterations.
impact: This approach can make LLM-based optimization more practical for real-world use, especially when compute budgets are limited. It is useful for researchers and practitioners who need strong results without paying for expensive model calls at every step.

paper_title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
paper_authors: Hui Chen, Xuan Qi, James Xu Zhao, Zhaopeng Feng, Shilong Liu
